parties: Suraweera Aratchige Babinona v. V. Karunaratne and Others Suraweera Aratchige Babinona v. V. Karunaratne and Others View More
keywords: The 30th Defendant-Appellant challenged the allocation of shares in a partition action, based on the fact that the District Court had failed to properly consider the chain of title and certain deeds affecting the devolution of shares. Held - The allocation of shares had to be determined precisely. The validity and effect of deed depended on the relevant devolution of title and the application of Sections 66(1) and 66(2) of the Partition Act.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Partition Act
